speaker: abel_garnish
text: The plot is on its peg. I will walk them through the lists until they can find their own feet, and then I will stop walking them. A list is not a tutor.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Leave them the doors. I have a prison to say to nobody, and nobody is the right house for it this morning.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Say it, then. The bare stage is as much audience as a Tuesday rehearsal has earned.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I wasted time, and now doth time waste me.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Again. Once is a memory. Twice is a shape.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I wasted time, and now doth time waste me.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: That is the speech. Thou hast it. I am not going to improve a line that has already found an empty house and survived it.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Does the gown show, sir? From the door, I mean. I cannot see my own hem, and I would rather know now than on Thursday with the yard in it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It does not show. The gown is doing what a gown is for. Thou art not to tug it, and thou art not to ask the yard to notice it.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Then I will leave it. A hem that does not show is a hem I can trust, which is more than I can say for a new one.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: If the seam showed, I would have it on the plot as a fault. It is not on the plot. The boy may stop asking.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He has stopped. I heard him stop. That is the end of the gown for this morning.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Sweet Master Shakespeare. How does the sweet tooth?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It keeps its own counsel, and its counsel is bad. You will have a better report after Thursday, if I have a mouth left to give it.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I asked from politeness, which is a rare mood and should be encouraged. I have no roll in your king. I am saving myself for a dance, where a tooth is less of a critic.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Save yourself. There is nowhere in the king to put you, and I am not cutting a hole for a dance in the middle of a prison.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: He is not on the plot. I would have said so if anyone had asked me to write him in. Nobody asked. The jig is after, and the jig is not my tally.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Let the jig be after. This morning is the prison, and the prison does not want a comic at the door correcting the time. Thou heard it twice, Will. Is twice enough for thee?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Twice is enough. I will not make thee say it a third time to the same empty air. The air has been very patient.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: And the gown is settled, sir. I will not ask again today. Thursday I may forget that I promised, and you may remind me without a speech.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will remind thee with a look, which is cheaper. Go and be still somewhere. Still was yesterday's lesson and it has not expired.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Sweet Master Shakespeare grows stern. The tooth is teaching him manners. I approve, and I am leaving before the approval is taxed.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Go, all of you who are not dead in a prison. I will walk the line once more alone, and I do not want a note from the yard about it, there being no yard.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The lists are learned. I am done. If a man misses his door on Thursday it will not be because I failed to show it to him this morning.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then the morning is the morning. I am going home to say Gaunt at a window, where the only witness is a jaw. God keep thee, Dick. The twice was the right number.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: God keep thee. Eat nothing that argues. I will see thee when the king is nearer, and not before I must.
